newsitem.title: USA: Aura Systems names Papazian president.
newsitem.headline: Aura Systems names Papazian president.

text.p: Aura Systems Inc said on Monday that it named Gerald Papazian as president and chief operating officer.

"I will now be able to concentrate on Aura's longer range business, technical and financial planning and on forming strategic alliances," Harry Kurtzman, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

Papazian, 41, has been at Aura for nine years. He was recently senior vice president-administration. Before working at Aura, Papazian had been a vice president, corporate finance at Bear Stearns & Co.
